#include <assert.h>
#include <stdint.h>
#include <stdio.h>

#include "crawlberg.h"

int main(void) {
    CBERGAlefHandle config_handle = cberg_crawl_config_from_json("{}");
    CBERGAlefHandle engine = cberg_create_engine(config_handle);
    cberg_crawl_config_free(config_handle);
    char url[2048];
    snprintf(url, sizeof(url), "%s", "https://example.com/target");
    CBERGAlefHandle result = cberg_batch_scrape(engine, url);
    if (result != 0) cberg_batch_scrape_results_free(result);
    cberg_crawl_engine_handle_free(engine);
    return EXIT_SUCCESS;
}
